title: LEGOLAND Discovery Center Philadelphia Admission Ticket
includes: Admission to Legoland Discovery Center Philadelphia
Food and drinks (available for purchase) (not included)
Master Build Academy (available for purchase) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must wear socks in the soft play area
Please note: As a children's attraction and to promote a safe and family-friendly environment, adults cannot enter without being accompanied by a child
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Unleash your kids’ creativity at LEGOLAND® Discovery Center Philadelphia, the ultimate indoor LEGO® playground for families. Your admission ticket includes access to interactive attractions like the LEGO Ninjago Training Camp, DUPLO® Park, Miniland’s miniature Philly landmarks, and high-speed LEGO Racers. Enjoy a 4D cinema experience, then hop on family-friendly rides like Imagination Express for a full day of LEGO-building fun in Philadelphia.
